overview.description: The 21Shares Ethereum Staking ETF (TETH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long eth, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that seeks to track the price performance of spot ether, less expenses and liabilities of the trust. TETH was launched on Jul 22, 2024 and is issued by 21Shares.
